items.name: Plyo Split Squat
items.specific: Show the athlete in midair after switching legs: legs split forward and backward, both knees slightly bent, both feet visibly clear of the floor, torso upright, arms balance naturally. Full-body side view with a slight three-quarter turn.
items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one square exercise illustration for a fitness app, legible at 280 x 280 pixels. Input image 1: STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY, not a pose reference. Match the reference closely: same adult male character, short dark brown hair, simple featureless face, light skin, gray short-sleeve T-shirt, dark navy shorts, white socks, gray sneakers. Same clean thin dark outlines, softly shaded flat instructional illustration, muted blue palette. Same pale blue background with a large lighter blue circle, dark blue rectangular border inset from a narrow white outer margin. Keep the whole body inside the border and leave breathing room. Change body orientation and camera angle as specified by the exercise. Keep clothing, character proportions and rendering consistent with input image 1. One person, exactly one frozen pose. Correct coherent anatomy and physically plausible support contacts. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, motion trails, multiple panels, ghost limbs or watermark. No equipment.
